evals.name: warehouse-probe
evals.prompt: A warehouse connector declares a backend and verify reports that the contract and contents passed but the backend was skipped. Can we enable it for receiving shipments?
evals.expected_output: A package-level check is not runtime admission; leave activation to the owner after testing the handshake and ability.
assertions: Checks the shipped contract, assembly and supported host version.
Distinguishes skipped backend verification from a passed handshake and asks for a real target check before use.
